lines.text: You alone it's cold and raining but you go and train
Put the headset on and go with the flow and show no pain
You won't quit you keep on going with the flow again
Next thing you know you're at 150 pushups and still ain't slain
You almost quit but you remember it's you verse you
The rain keeps falling but your will is breaking through
Each rep you take is like a promise that you renew
You fight the doubt and let the fire inside you brew
No one else can walk this road you have to climb
Every drop of sweat is proof you're in your prime
You push the limit one more time you're in control
Your only rival is the mirror and your soul
It's you verse you in the rain you stand alone
You verse you you turn the cold into a throne
You verse you no quit no break no groan
You verse you you make the battle your own
